name: MultiSelectLookup
description: Multi-select lookup control for Dataverse / Model-Driven apps. Renders a searchable, tag based multi-select backed by Dataverse records and persists the chosen record ids as a delimited string.

defaultSelectedItems.description: The record ids that are selected when the form opens. Accepts a semicolon (or custom) delimited list of primary key values. This is the bound field of the control.

entityName.description: Logical name of the table to look up records from, for example 'account'.

displayProperty.description: Logical name of the attribute shown as the record label, for example 'name'.

primaryIdAttribute.description: Logical name of the primary id attribute used to match and persist selections. When empty the form context value (PrimaryIdAttribute) is used.

entitySetName.description: Optional override for the OData entity set used in requests. Leave empty to derive it from the form context.

placeholderText.description: Text shown in the control when nothing is selected.

labelText.description: Label rendered above the control. When empty the label is hidden and only the placeholder is used.

selectedItemsDelimiter.description: Character used to separate the selected record ids in the bound field.

maxOptions.description: Maximum number of records fetched in a single request.

allowSearch.description: Shows a search box above the option list.

showSelectAll.description: Shows the 'Select all' and 'Clear all' shortcuts in the callout footer.

isDisabled.description: Prevents the user from opening the control and changing the selection.

isRequired.description: Marks the control as required and blocks save while the selection is empty.

errorMessage.description: Overrides the default required field error message.

outputs.name: value
outputs.description: The delimited list of selected record ids, written back to the bound field.

outputs.name: selectedRecords
outputs.description: Comma separated list of selected record ids, for use with rules and formulas.
